description.zh: 只忽略 Asset Store 导入产物：Assets/AssetStoreTools*（含其 meta）与 *.unitypackage；不含 Unity 生成目录与 IDE 文件，需与其它模板配合。
description.en: Only Asset Store import artifacts: Assets/AssetStoreTools* (including its meta) and *.unitypackage; it contains no generated folders or IDE files, so combine it with another template.
